subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Break new ground

options.text: Dig fresh ground for sowing seeds

solution:
The correct answer is **'Do or discover something new'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'Break new group'** is **'Do or discover something new'.**
 
• **Break new ground**: do something innovative that is regarded as an advance or of positive benefit. (कुछ नया करना जिसे अग्रिम या सकारात्मक लाभ के रूप में माना जाता है)
 
 
• *Example: With the use of computer-generated imagery, the film **broke new ground.***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Do or discover something new.*
